campaign.days: Days 4 to 20: the Long Winter and Fimbulwinter.
decree.d4: Freyja has claimed her share of the slain. Each day she names a whim; the worthy who match it go to Fólkvangr.
decree.d5: A sea battle. The drowned belong to Rán, whatever they tell you.
whim.amber: Freyja claims whoever wears amber today.
shop.sundial.text: Skögul teaches you to read the sun. Each shift gets 30 more seconds.
